intro: Pacific Palisades is rebuilding after the January 2025 Palisades Fire. Palisades Village reopened in August 2026 after a $100 million restoration, and a growing list of local restaurants, shops and trails are open again. This guide lists only places confirmed open, and it grows as more return.
